senses.gloss: m. (פְּרַס I) division, arrangement, order, proper time (cmp. קֵץ).
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 129b:3">Sabb. 129ᵇ</cite> <he>פ׳ דדמא כל וכ׳</he> the order (proper period) for blood-letting is every thirty days; <he>פ׳ דדמא חד וכ׳</he> the order (proper day) for blood-letting is the first day of the week &c.
<cite ref="Gittin 37a:1">Gitt. 37ᵃ</cite> (explaining <he>פרוסבול</he>) <he>פ׳ דמילתא</he> the arrangement (institution) of a measure.
